aboutPage.title: Who We Are
aboutPage.missionText: To prove that top-tier talent can compete and win at a global level in competitive gaming. We are not here to participate. We are here to dominate, write history, and change the perception of competitive gaming on the international stage.
aboutPage.visionText: TALENTS LAB is more than a team. It is a brand, a community, a movement. We want to create a space where talent comes together, trains, competes, and wins. A platform where players become champions, creators build global audiences, and fans experience the thrill of competitive gaming at the highest level.

values.title: Excellence
values.description: We accept no compromises. Every detail, every decision, every action reflects our commitment to absolute excellence.

values.title: Dedication
values.description: Our players train like the best athletes in the world. Total dedication to competition.

values.title: Community
values.description: We are never alone. Our strength comes from the community. Whether players, fans, or partners, we are a family.

values.title: Innovation
values.description: We constantly seek new training methods, new strategies, and new ways to tell the gaming story.

values.title: Transparency
values.description: We communicate honestly with our fans, partners, and community. No empty hype, only facts.

values.title: Ambition
values.description: We dream big. From a local team to a global force in the international scene.

storyParagraphs: TALENTS LAB was born from the awareness that competitive gaming needed a new point of reference. Not just another team, but an organization that combines talent, ambition, and professionalism at the level of the best European teams.
In the 2026 season, we recruited some of the best Brawl Stars players. Not to participate in tournaments, but to win them.

But TALENTS LAB is also growth. It is our Academy, where we select and train the talents of the future. It is our creator and streamer community that tells the story of competitive gaming to the world. It is our vision of a competitive, united, and self-aware scene.

The site you are visiting is not just a showcase. It is the heart of our movement. Here we tell our story day by day, share our progress, celebrate our successes, and remain vulnerable about our failures.

articles.title: Welcome to the future of TALENTS LAB: the new official website is live!
articles.excerpt: Today marks the beginning of a new chapter: the official launch of the global TALENTS LAB Esports web platform. Not simply a competitive club, but a cutting-edge vision born to redefine the boundaries of international gaming.
articles.content: Today marks the beginning of a new chapter: the official launch of the global TALENTS LAB Esports web platform. We are not simply a competitive club; we are a cutting-edge vision born to redefine the boundaries of international gaming through excellence, strategic innovation, and the scouting of the best global talents. This portal represents our manifesto and the meeting point between the passion of the community and the highest competitive standards in the industry. It will be the main space where we tell our story, share the milestones of our rosters, and build the future of competitive entertainment together with our partners. Our Mission: Recognize pure, raw talent, shape it through a micro-structured growth path, and lead it to dominate the stages of the world circuits. Our Community: We are not looking for simple spectators. We want to unite fans, dreamers, and players who believe in change and in the winning mentality. Welcome to TALENTS LAB. The future starts now.

articles.title: European podium! TALENTS LAB takes third place at the August Monthly Finals
articles.excerpt: TALENTS LAB is officially on the European podium: a legendary third place at the August Monthly Finals EMEA, with an emergency line-up and a run stopped only in the semi-final by FUT Esports.
articles.content: TALENTS LAB is officially on the podium of Europe. The boys delivered an extraordinary performance at the August Monthly Finals EMEA, claiming a legendary third place overall. The monthly finals stage put the squad to a severe test, forcing it to face the event with an emergency line-up: alongside Yei Yei and Sanfire, the outstanding stand-in Mewtu stepped onto the stage and slotted into the team's mechanics instantly, with the ease of a top-class player. The quarter-final against Reply Totem was a masterpiece of technique and steady nerves, ending 3-2 in our favour at the end of an extremely tense series. Our run was stopped only in the semi-final against FUT Esports, currently the number one team in Europe and a favourite for the world title. This defeat does not erase a journey worthy of giants: an incredible performance that proved once and for all that the TLB acronym belongs by right on the most important stages in the world. This podium is only the beginning of an immense journey. 2027 will be historic. Dream Bigger!

articles.title: Historic feat at the Monthly Qualifier: TALENTS LAB flies to the Monthly Finals!
articles.excerpt: A monumental feat at the European Monthly Qualifier: a reverse sweep against NOVO Esports and a clean 3-1 over Team Heretics seal a historic qualification for the EMEA Monthly Finals.
articles.content: A legendary day that will be written in golden letters in the history of TALENTS LAB. Our team, made up of Agachi, Sanfire, and Yei Yei, pulled off a monumental feat during the European Monthly Qualifier, earning a historic qualification for the EMEA Monthly Finals of the official Brawl Stars Championship circuit. The road to this milestone was a genuine nail-biter. The most epic moment of the tournament came during the decisive head-to-head against NOVO Esports: two sets down (0-2) and one step away from elimination, the boys kept an extraordinary mental composure, pulling off a stunning "reverse sweep" to a final 3-2 that left every spectator speechless. Without giving themselves a moment's rest, the team went back on stage and defeated the giants of Team Heretics with a clean and hugely elegant 3-1. With this outstanding display, TALENTS LAB proves it is no simple outsider, but that it has everything it takes to sit at the table of the true giants of Europe.

articles.title: TALENTS LAB secures the official pass for the Brawl Ball League
articles.excerpt: Our team clears the groups with a perfect record and secures the official pass for the Brawl Ball League, one of the most iconic and competitive tournaments on the continental scene.
articles.content: The European journey of TALENTS LAB begins with an extraordinary show of strength that immediately makes the international ambitions of the club clear. Yesterday evening, our team made up of Yei Yei, Agachi, and Tomzy brilliantly cleared the qualifying groups, securing the official pass for the prestigious Brawl Ball League, one of the most iconic and competitive tournaments on the continental scene. The team chemistry and strategic aggression the boys showed from the very first matches left their opponents with no answers. Perfect synergy in map control and millimetre-precise timing in managing goals allowed TLB to close the qualifying stage with a perfect record, without conceding a single set. This achievement is the first, fundamental building block of our great competitive project for the 2026 season. The road ahead is still long, but the Talents Lab era has officially begun and we are ready to leave our mark on every field of play.

articles.title: TALENTS LAB unveils the official Brawl Stars roster
articles.excerpt: It is official. TALENTS LAB announces its entry into the international competitive Brawl Stars circuit with an elite lineup led by three absolute champions: Yei Yei, Tomzy, and Agachi.
articles.content: It is official. TALENTS LAB announces its entry into the international competitive Brawl Stars circuit with an elite lineup led by three absolute champions: Yei Yei, Tomzy, and Agachi. This roster combines devastating firepower with unprecedented strategic draft reading, laying the foundations for a season focused solely on the top of the global rankings. The goals for this year are extremely ambitious: dominate the most prestigious international tournaments, conquer the top of European and global qualifications, and establish the brand as the absolute reference point in next-generation competitive gaming. The team is ready to enter the battlefield with determination, constantly supported by the work of the Academy and the club's entire management. Follow our official channels so you do not miss the next matches and all the exclusive behind-the-scenes content!

privacy.pageDescription: We protect your data with care. This policy describes how we collect and use newsletter emails and how we will handle shop data in the future.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose of collection
paragraphs: TALENTS LAB collects the email address you enter in the "Stay Updated" box solely to send you communications about merchandise launches, drops, events and project updates.

sections.heading: 2. Data processed
paragraphs: The personal data processed is your email. We do not collect sensitive information, credit card numbers or banking data through this form.

sections.heading: 3. Processing methods
paragraphs: Data will be stored securely and used for commercial communication and marketing purposes related to TALENTS LAB. Every message sent will contain a link to unsubscribe.

sections.heading: 4. Future shop and external partners
paragraphs: When the store goes live, shop data will be handled in accordance with the policies of Shopify and Printful. This means that order, shipping and payment data will be stored and protected by the respective providers under their terms of service.
At the moment, the site uses email collection for the newsletter only. E-commerce services are not yet operational, but they will be activated following the best security and privacy practices.

sections.heading: 5. Rights of the data subject
paragraphs: You have the right to access, rectify or delete your information, as well as to request the restriction of processing and to object to direct marketing. Send a request by email to bstalentslab@gmail.com.

sections.heading: 6. Duration and updates
paragraphs: This policy may be updated at any time. The version published on this page is the one currently in force.

cookie.pageDescription: We explain which cookies the site uses and why they are necessary for the web experience and for the future integration of the Shopify cart.

sections.heading: 1. What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored in the browser when you visit a site. They are used to remember preferences, browsing sessions and technical settings.

sections.heading: 2. Necessary technical cookies
paragraphs: TALENTS LAB uses technical cookies strictly necessary for the operation of the site, such as session management, navigation between pages and error protection.

sections.heading: 3. Future Shopify cart
paragraphs: When the store goes live, the site may use additional cookies from the Shopify platform to manage the cart, checkout and purchase personalization.
These cookies will be used to ensure a safe and continuous experience during online purchases.

sections.heading: 4. Third-party cookies
paragraphs: At the moment, no profiling or marketing cookies are activated. In the future, any external services will be handled according to the providers' policies and only with your consent when required.

sections.heading: 5. Management and deactivation
paragraphs: You can manage cookies directly from your browser. Disabling technical cookies may affect the correct functioning of the site.

sections.heading: 6. Updates
paragraphs: This Cookie Policy may be updated at any time. The version published on this page is the current one.
